checks_run: Inventoried all 64 regular files, inspected learner, sealed, provenance, manifest, audit, runner, test, starter, and reference materials, and confirmed the aggregate candidate checksum before and after review.
Recorded the exact configured Python, Java, and javac paths and versions.
Parsed MANIFEST.yaml and PROVENANCE.json and reran environment/audit.py with the pinned Python toolchain.
Compiled the starter with javac -Xlint:all -Werror and reran the public and sealed suites with the pinned JDK under external timeouts in a writable scratch replica.
Reviewed lexer, parser, interpreter, compiler, VM, CLI, tests, documentation, validation claims, progressive-disclosure layout, and license/provenance boundary.
Compiled and ran an independent bounded Java probe for numeric underflow, finite and infinite engine-budget parity, malformed-bytecode rejection, and CLI behavior.
evidence: The claimed packaging audit reproduced: 23/23 required files, 21/21 forbidden paths absent, 64 regular files, no symlinks/special files, and zero credential-pattern hits.
The starter compiled; the public suite passed 9/9 against the sealed reference; the sealed suite passed 16/16. The intentionally incomplete starter failed 0/9 with disclosed TODO exceptions.
A valid finite program completed under TREE with [6000] but VM raised LIMIT at 3:247 because its raw-instruction guard preempted the shared semantic budget.
An infinite compiler-produced program raised LIMIT at 2:14 under TREE and 3:267 under VM, violating required error-location parity.
The nonzero literal formed as 0. followed by 400 zeroes and 1 was accepted as 0.0 instead of raising the required out-of-range LEX error.
A BytecodeProgram containing HALT followed by a null instruction returned [] instead of rejecting malformed bytecode.

Validation labeling is otherwise candid: the manifest remains GENERATED and PARTIAL, and fuzzing, benchmarking, transfer verification, productionization, and stronger validation labels are explicitly not claimed.
The aggregate candidate checksum was d4df8869e21fb0eb2568acbb5a88ca610f4544afa2c2defa5bcb44abb4a82faa both before and after review.
limitations: The immutable upstream catalog snapshot and linked resource were unavailable, so source hashes, CC0 evidence, and the no-copy assertion could only be checked for internal consistency.
The full candidate physically contains sealed reference code and tests; no independently captured learner-view export was available to prove those paths are excluded.
CANDIDATE was mounted read-only, so runners that create local build directories were exercised in a scratch replica; the submitted tree itself was not modified.
No fuzzing, benchmark, transfer, production, or orchestrator acceptance validation was performed, and no such label is awarded by this advisory review.
